sections.description:
Short title, extent and commencement

ACT IV OF 1991
ACT IV OF 1991
NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE REVISION OF RECORD-OF-RIGHTS (VALIDATION)
ACT, 1991
An Act to validate the Revision of Record-of-Rights in the District of
Bannu, Mardan and Swabi
[Gazette of N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 26th March, 1991]
No. PA/NWFP/Legis/91/5131, dated
26-3-1991.--The North-West Frontier Province Revision of Record-of-Rights
(Validation) Bill,1991 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the
North-West Frontier Province on the 12th March, 1991 and assented to by the Governor
of the North-West Frontier Province on 21st March, 1991, is hereby published as
an Act of the Provincial Legislature of North-West Frontier Province.
1. Short title, extent and commencement.--(l) This Act may be
called the North-West Frontier Province Revision of Record-of-Rights
(Validation) Act, 1991.
(2) It shall extend to the
District of Bannu, Mardan and Swabi.
(3) It shall come into force at
once.

ACT IV OF 1991
ACT IV OF 1991
NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE REVISION OF RECORD-OF-RIGHTS (VALIDATION)
ACT, 1991
An Act to validate the Revision of Record-of-Rights in the District of
Bannu, Mardan and Swabi
[Gazette of N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 26th March, 1991]
No. PA/NWFP/Legis/91/5131, dated
26-3-1991.--The North-West Frontier Province Revision of Record-of-Rights
(Validation) Bill,1991 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the
North-West Frontier Province on the 12th March, 1991 and assented to by the Governor
of the North-West Frontier Province on 21st March, 1991, is hereby published as
an Act of the Provincial Legislature of North-West Frontier Province.
2. Validation of certain action.--Notwithstanding the
non-publication of the Revenue Department's Notification No. 19738/S&CH/55.
Sett., dated the 8th September,1982, as required by section 2r (41)
of the West Pakistan General Clauses Act, 1956 (W.P. Act VI of 1956), or any
other law for the time being in force, or any judgment, decree or order of any Court
or other authority, the special revision of right-of-records done in the
Districts of Bannu, Mardan and Swabi in pursuance of the Notification referred
to above shall be valid and shall always be deemed valid for all intents and
purposes of the West Pakistan Land Revenue Act, 1967 (W.P. Act XVII of 1907).
